test_run.fixtures: Temporary synthetic fixtures with mocked Popen, process scans, closure and Git tools; no actual scientific processes or Git commands.

reviewed_behaviors: Read-only default preflight; execute requires exact config SHA, self source ref, pinned guard/auth and immutable input refs.
Finite1..64 earlier-dependent jobs; direct pinned Python argv with one fresh output; explicit success statuses/typed required fields; one attempt per job.
Every scientific, ML and analysis payload is launched serially through the frozen new guardian; finite CPU/wall/thread limits and actual remaining allocation/deadline checked before launch.
Actual closed guardian row must bind exact worker SHA, output and fully materialized argv; known failed closure is distinguished from unknown process ownership.
Known closed failure retains failed cost, skips dependents and allows independent jobs to continue. No automatic rerun or hidden retry.
Unknown, running or orphan closure blocks resume, subsequent science and Git return; missing PID alone never closes a phase.

Independent process scan checks live owned child identity even for a non-Python executable, configured and unconfigured scientific worker families, guardians and Git. It does not infer safety from a quiet ledger alone.
Detach startup waits at most1s for only the exact source/config/UID/PID-birth/boot-bound actual parent launcher, then performs ordinary process scanning without exemptions.

Artifact return holds the global native-work lock, requires closed ledger/process scan, exact research branch and initially empty staged index, verified expected GitHub remote, bounded explicit extension/path/size selection.

Raw log bytes remain verbatim; cached models/checkpoints/large arrays are retained locally and excluded. Small CSV gzip must decode as bounded rectangular UTF-8 CSV with records; sha256 metadata syntax is checked.

Selected source bytes are hashed before staging, checked after staging and compared to actual committed blobs before push; remote branch HEAD is verified after scientific and receipt pushes. No force push/main merge.
Upload transport failure preserves local science/index and records failure without scientific reruns; source/config/dependency hashes are rechecked between jobs and on sealed resume.
material_scope_limits: This receipt reviews the frozen516-line orchestration source, not a not-yet-final root execution config. Job dependencies and scientific acceptance must be explicit in the final pinned config.
Synthetic tests do not assert future host availability or future live monitor health. Root separately reports the real643 guard probe; it was not launched by this reviewer.
Resource guard and driver enforce finite execution/closure; the worker and protocol must independently validate numerical science and checkpoint geometry/full-space bindings.
